name: Saleyee Dropship Wholesale
description: Cross-border dropshipping wholesale supplier platform with 30,000+ verified products stored in local US/UK/EU warehouses.
fullDescription: Saleyee provides a turnkey wholesale dropshipping and supply chain solution for cross-border e-commerce merchants. By stocking over 30,000 fast-selling SKUs directly in local fulfillment centers across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe, sellers can achieve 2-8 day delivery without holding inventory.
features: Local fulfillment from warehouses in US, UK, Germany, and France
Zero membership fees and wholesale pricing discounts on volume
Automated inventory and order synchronization for Amazon, eBay, and Shopify
Fast 48-hour order dispatch with trackable FedEx, UPS, and DHL labels
Dedicated account managers and responsive after-sales replacement guarantees
